hints.title: Two Pointers for Tag Game
hints.text: Maintain one pointer i traversing "it" players (value 1) and another pointer j traversing non-"it" players (value 0).

hints.title: Greedy Earliest Catch
hints.text: An "it" player at i catches a target at j if abs(i - j) <= dist. Greedily pair the earliest available "it" with the earliest available non-"it".

hints.title: Advancing Out-of-Range Pointers
hints.text: If j < i - dist, player j can never be caught by i or any future "it", so advance j. If j > i + dist, player i cannot catch j, so advance i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Two-pointer greedy matching across the team array in a single pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Graph maximum bipartite matching with Ford-Fulkerson takes O(V * E) which is too slow for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Monotonic indices allow greedy matching in O(N) time with O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize greedy two-pointer matching with bounds checking.
